title: Explain-in-Plain-English prompt comprehension labs
summary: Students inspect Python-like functions and describe them in natural language so GPT-3.5 generates functionally equivalent code. PrairieLearn runs instructor tests on the generated code and returns both code and test results for iterative prompt revision.

sources.title: Prompting for Comprehension: Exploring the Intersection of Explain in Plain English Questions and Prompt Writing
sources.evidence_quote: A total of eight questions were used across two separate lab assignments

assessment.summary: Complete eight code-comprehension questions across two labs.
student_actions: Read a function with generic names.
Write a plain-English description of its purpose.
Inspect LLM-generated code and unit-test feedback.
Revise the description for up to 20 attempts.

student_role.description: GPT-3.5 generated code from every submitted description as the core grading mechanism.

grading.method: PrairieLearn graded functional equivalence with unit tests; incorrect attempts were not penalized.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: 841 of 889 enrolled students participated; completion rates across eight tasks ranged from 96.3% to 99.8%.
